selection: Explicit directory star/question and whole-component globstar; bounded case-insensitive matching below resolved literal prefix; old flat patterns retain call-specific semantics
move: Explicit RD/FR swap retains complete relative directories and bytes; no mkdir; complete busy/collision/physical alias/quota preflight then ordered per-file publication
listing: Sorted complete keys before skip/page/format0..4; busy descriptors visible without payload read or flush; stage complete page and preserve unused slots
bounds: 254-character paths, 32767 scanned entries, budgeted traversal and matching; reject encountered links/junctions
persistence: Ordinary bytes/device accounting only; no live descriptors, cursor or glob plans
boundary: Authored offline extension; late MOVE failures may retain earlier files; no filesystem transaction, native compiler/controller or strict equivalence
